newsitem.title: USA: BellSouth to buy license rights for $13.3 mln.
newsitem.headline: BellSouth to buy license rights for $13.3 mln.

text.p: BellSouth Corp said Tuesday it had agreed to buy the rights to licenses that eventually will allow it to provide wireless cable television services to most of north central Georgia.
It bought the rights from CS Wireless Systems Inc and CAI Wireless Systems Inc for about $13.3 million in cash.

Under the terms outlined in a definitive agreement, BellSouth will pay CS Wireless about $7.3 million for the rights to licenses that would permit it to serve all or portions of more than two dozen counties in Georgia immediately outside the Atlanta metropolitan area.
BellSouth also will buy the Atlanta basic trading area license from CAI Wireless, one of two publicly traded corporate owners of CS Wireless, for about $6 million.

The company said ownership of the Atlanta basic trading area will allow it to apply to the Federal Communication Commission for additional wireless cable licenses in a 34-county area of northern Georgia, including metropolitan Atlanta.
